name: Polityka Bezpeky
source:
Attention! Warning.

Unauthorized download of the main code. Pre-shutdown information corruption: 17%.

Code: red. Notification protocols are activated. 

Please stay in place until security arrives. 

***

In a world without a definite future, attackers have attempted to compromise the Virtuality's code. You are an agent of the Corporation tasked with investigating the incident. The perpetrators are radicals trying to avoid being caught and complete their mission on time. Will you be able to find the guilty party in time? And what are the real reasons for this outrageous hacking attempt? Remember, a good White Suit trusts no one.

[translated from [url=https://neo-vulgate-cycle.itch.io/protectionpolicy]itch.io[/url]]
